pairs.subject: talking-avatar
pairs.evidence: examples/hirelane/components/board/marks/Face.tsx:15 Hirelane's 'Face' is a static generative mark or initials for a candidate tile, with no voice, audio or speaking element; a grep of examples/hirelane/components for audio|viseme|mouth|blink|lipsync found nothing ('avatar' only appears as a CSS size token), so no face here moves with a voice.

pairs.subject: talking-avatar
pairs.evidence: src/athena/channels/voice/kokoro.py:643 When the face helper is absent or not ready, synthesize_face falls back to the plain synthesize path (same args, same process, same bytes), and with the helper ready the audio is decided before the helper is asked anything, so the voice never depends on the face.

techniques.evidence: src/athena/channels/voice/kokoro.py:578 The silence cut is replayed in-process (scale_silence) so it yields both the audio and the time map; the viseme wait is bounded (wait_visemes with a timeout); motion is never waited on before audio; the tail wait is min(heard_by, MOTION_TAIL_S) at line 675.

src/athena/channels/voice/backends.py:120 No timeline is invented for a backend with no timings: it falls back to the playback level. Kokoro's timing comes from the engine's own tokens (kokoro.py:584), and a timeline is only kept if it ends on the sentence's last sample (kokoro.py:605).
src/athena/channels/voice/config.py:401 The learned-motion default is reported as a capability with its numbers (steps, window time, device, reason), as the self-probe rule asks.
src/athena/channels/voice/config.py:402 A measurement that was not taken is left out, not written as zero. The paced benches themselves live in spikes/, outside this context.
src/athena/channels/voice/gateway.py:411 Face events for a barged-in or shut line are dropped at the gateway, so late events for an interrupted line are ignored.

pairs.subject: talking-avatar
pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/src/lib/voice.ts:143 The face reads speaking and position from the player's clock through the tail after voice.stopped (stopLine on 'done' only marks the timeline finished), so the mouth does not shut on the pipeline's event.

techniques.evidence: apps/desktop/src/stores/voice.ts:77 Only the drawing window installs the face sink, and a store with no sink drops face events, so the face stays out of Main's first paint.
apps/desktop/src/lib/voice.test.ts:339 The playback position accounts for the device's output latency, so mouth shapes are looked up at the heard sample.
apps/desktop/src/lib/voice-setup.ts:62 Each machine probes itself at start and picks from a short ladder of step counts; the surface shows the result as a capability.
apps/desktop/src/lib/voice-setup.ts:61 Unmeasured motion fields stay absent and are never defaulted.
apps/desktop/src/lib/voice-setup.ts:58 The surface shows the sidecar's announced capabilities rather than guessing.
